as_of_semantics.statement: Historical reliability evaluation uses the documented HISTORICAL_AVAILABILITY_ASSUMPTION. Production live mode remains evidence-only and currently cannot generate shadow probabilities until a verified finality source is connected.

market_timing.interpretation: Exact game/side/point contracts were matched; proportional de-vig and equal-mean consensus were used where applicable; quote timing is unknown. These results do NOT prove closing-line, T-60, or T-10 reliability.
market_timing.primary_label: schedule-reference historical reliability with unknown quote timestamp

production.historical_live_availability_limitation: Production live shadow availability still depends on a verified finality source; schedule-reference evaluation with unknown quote timestamp does not prove closing-line, T-60, or T-10 reliability.

terminology.statement: fundamental_probability is generated by the market-augmented EPA/rest shadow model and is not independent of the market.
